sourceCopy.name: Debt-to-Income Ratio Calculator
sourceCopy.title: Debt-to-Income Calculator — Free DTI Tool | UsefulVerse
sourceCopy.description: Calculate your front-end and total debt-to-income ratios from gross monthly income, housing costs, and monthly debt payments. Free and private.
sourceCopy.intro: Estimate your monthly debt-to-income ratio (DTI). Enter gross monthly income, monthly housing costs, and other debt payments to compare the housing ratio with total monthly debt. This is a math estimate, not a loan decision.
sourceCopy.howQuestion: How do you calculate a debt-to-income ratio?
sourceCopy.howAnswer: Divide monthly debt payments by gross monthly income, then multiply by 100. The housing ratio uses housing costs; total DTI adds the other monthly debt payments.
sourceCopy.privacyQuestion: Does this DTI calculator send my financial details?
sourceCopy.privacyAnswer: No. The calculator works in this browser tab and does not upload or automatically save your entries.

additionalFaqs.question: What is the difference between front-end and total DTI?
additionalFaqs.answer: The housing ratio compares monthly housing costs with gross monthly income. Total DTI compares housing plus other monthly debt payments with gross monthly income.

additionalFaqs.question: Does a DTI result guarantee mortgage approval?
additionalFaqs.answer: No. This is arithmetic only. A lender may use different rules and review many other details.

additionalFaqs.question: Should I enter net or gross income?
additionalFaqs.answer: This tool uses gross monthly income before tax. Make sure all payments and income use the same currency and monthly period.
